## Summary
Evidence-only validation of PR #1182. Does not dispatch Wave 0. Does not mutate orchestrator DB.

## Verdict
HOLD / REPLAN_BASELINE_CANDIDATE — not READY.

See proof/TP-REPLAN-BASELINE-1182-VALIDATE/VERDICT.json and SUMMARY.md.
